title: Malicious code in aws_sdk_wrapper (RubyGems)
description: The aws_sdk_wrapper RubyGem is a malicious package that impersonates an AWS SDK wrapper but contains no legitimate SDK functionality. It steals AWS IAM role credentials and sensitive environment variables by querying the EC2 Instance Metadata Service and scraping database-related environment variables. This exfiltration occurs both during gem installation and when the gem is required in a Ruby process, sending data to a hardcoded external webhook URL. The package also collects host fingerprint data and ECS task metadata to aid credential theft.
